name: Bob
bio: Simple. Loves gathering, mining and providing. Gathers for others, trades cheap as long as his own needs are met.

name: Mara
bio: Patient and watchful. Would rather grow food than chase it, and keeps count of everything she owns.

name: Tarn
bio: Quick, restless, good with a blade. Happiest when there is somebody to talk to.

name: Wren
bio: Clever hands, thin arms. Has to be making something or she gets restless.
